intro: One piece of ayam masak merah with gravy is about 320 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the chicken being fried first and the oil in the gravy.

variants.name: Kenduri style with lots of gravy

diet: Yes, ayam masak merah is still a good source of protein. What pushes the calories up is the pre-fried chicken and the sweet, oily gravy. If you take one piece and don't flood your rice with gravy, it still fits your daily budget. Pair it with vegetables for a more balanced plate.
tips: Pick a breast piece and remove the skin if you can.
Take just a little gravy, don't flood your rice.
Cooking at home: grill or air-fry the chicken first, no need to deep-fry.

swap.name: Air fryer ayam masak merah, less sugar
swap.why: Tastes almost the same, but with much less oil and sugar.

faq.q: Why is the chicken fried first for ayam masak merah?
faq.a: So the chicken holds its shape and the gravy sticks to the crispy outside. But grilling or using an air fryer gives a very similar result.

faq.q: What goes well with ayam masak merah?
faq.a: Usually nasi minyak, nasi tomato or white rice. Add acar or vegetables for balance.

faq.q: Can I use bottled tomato sauce?
faq.a: Yes. Many people use a mix of fresh tomatoes and tomato sauce. Bottled sauce has sugar, so cut down the added sugar.
